research_mode: official GOV.UK primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Cert Legal Scope
verified_claims: Firearm and shotgun certificate statistics cover legally held firearms and shotguns only.
limitations: The release provides no official estimate of illegally held firearms or shotguns.

sources.name: Cert Act Scope
verified_claims: The statistics report certificates issued by police forces under the Firearms Act 1968 as amended.
limitations: Certificate data do not measure all firearm-related crime or harm.

sources.name: Cert Monitoring Use
verified_claims: The data are used to monitor certificates on issue, guns held on certificate and certificate holders.
limitations: Monitoring counts are not evidence of risk at a particular address.

sources.name: Cert Coterminous Definition
verified_claims: A coterminous certificate arrangement aligns the expiry date of a shotgun certificate with a firearm certificate.
limitations: Coterminous status does not indicate the number or risk of weapons held.

sources.name: Cert Firearm Contents
verified_claims: A firearm certificate lists the number, type and serial number of each weapon and any conditions attached.
limitations: Published aggregate statistics do not expose certificate-level serial numbers or conditions.

sources.name: Cert Shotgun Contents
verified_claims: A shotgun certificate includes descriptions of shotguns and identification numbers where known.
limitations: An aggregate shotgun count cannot identify a particular holder or premises.

sources.name: Cert Temporary Permit
verified_claims: Police may issue temporary permits in limited circumstances, including delayed renewal processing or estate administration.
limitations: A temporary permit should not be treated as a full certificate or as evidence of misconduct.

sources.name: Cert Visitor Permit
verified_claims: A visitor's permit can authorise possession without a domestic certificate and cannot exceed 12 months.
limitations: Visitor permits do not establish permanent residence or ownership.

sources.name: Cert Issue Timeseries
verified_claims: Certificates on issue were collected once in 1971 and annually from 1983.
limitations: Time-series interpretation must account for gaps and collection changes.

sources.name: Cert Application Timeseries
verified_claims: New and renewal applications have been collected annually since 1983.
limitations: Application counts are not the same as certificates granted.

sources.name: Cert Weapon Count Timeseries
verified_claims: Numbers of firearms and shotguns covered by certificates have been collected annually since 1995.
limitations: Weapon counts before 1995 are not available on the same basis.

sources.name: Cert Revocation Timeseries
verified_claims: Certificate revocations have been collected annually since 1992.
limitations: A revocation count does not reveal the reason or risk associated with a specific case.

sources.name: Cert Dealer Timeseries
verified_claims: Registered firearm dealer statistics have been collected annually since 1995.
limitations: Dealer counts do not measure transaction volumes or local firearm prevalence.

sources.name: Cert Holder Demographics
verified_claims: Holder age and gender statistics have been collected annually since the year ending March 2016.
limitations: The available gender field is limited and missing selections are reported as unknown.

sources.name: Cert Lost Stolen Timeseries
verified_claims: Lost and stolen firearm and shotgun statistics have been collected annually since the year ending March 2021.
limitations: The short time series limits long-term comparison.

sources.name: Cert Temporary Timeseries
verified_claims: Temporary permit statistics have been collected since the year ending March 2023.
limitations: Early temporary-permit data should be treated as a developing short series.

sources.name: Cert Live Nflms
verified_claims: Certificate statistics are drawn from the live National Firearms Licensing Management System and can change as records are updated.
limitations: Extract dates must be preserved when comparing published values.

sources.name: Cert Quality Assurance
verified_claims: Home Office statisticians use outlier, variance, plausibility and second-statistician checks with police forces.
limitations: Quality assurance does not eliminate all recording and classification errors.

sources.name: Cert Covid Effect
verified_claims: Certificate data for years ending March 2021 and March 2022 were affected by COVID-19 restrictions.
limitations: Temporary pandemic effects should not be interpreted as permanent trend shifts.

sources.name: Cert System Break
verified_claims: The move to the national licensing system created limitations around 2006 to 2008, and later data can still contain recording or classification errors.
limitations: Series across the system transition require explicit comparability warnings.
